**The API Playground requires sign-in and spends real balance.** Every request you send from it is a real, billed call. The [Sandbox](https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/appendix/sandbox/) is the only free route to practise on, and it answers with dummy data, not live results.
1. ### Get your credentials
Sign in, open **API access**, and copy your API login and the generated API password — it is not the password you sign in with.
`app.dataforseo.com/api-access`[How authentication works →](https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/auth/)

### Where do I find my API login and password?
In the dashboard, under [API access](https://app.dataforseo.com/api-access). The API password is generated automatically by DataForSEO and is different from your account password. [Authentication](https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/auth/) is HTTP Basic and nothing else: there is no separate auth call, and credentials cannot be passed as URL parameters.

title: DataForSEO API v3 Pricing – Transparent Pay-As-You-Go Pricing Model
snippet:
Transparent pay-as-you-go pricing for DataForSEO APIs. Find the API you need, understand how it is billed, and view the detailed pricing page for exact rates and parameters.
- Pay as you go
- No subscriptions
- **$50** minimum top-up
- Balance never expires

Can I try DataForSEO APIs for free?
Yes. You can sign up for free and use your $1 trial credit available to new accounts for trying our APIs in the Playground section of your DataForSEO Dashboard, via MCP in your preferred AI tool, or through our ready-made templates and integrations with platforms like n8n, Postman, Google Sheets. You can also test API integration for free using the DataForSEO Sandbox. The Sandbox provides sample responses for testing, while trial credit lets you test paid API functionality.

### Live mode
$2.00
per 1,000 SERPs, pay as you go, nothing upfront

The minimum payment is $50, and DataForSEO says larger payments add funds to the account. Payment is by card, PayPal or Amazon Pay below $5,000, and wire transfer or ACH above it. The DataForSEO SERP API pricing above is for Google organic results; Maps, News, Images, Jobs and the other engines each have their own page and their own rates.

DataForSEO does not issue an API key. It uses Basic Authentication with an API login and an API password, both shown in the API Access tab of the dashboard.
### Two credentials, not one
And neither is your account password.
- The API login is the email address on the account.
- The API password is generated by DataForSEO.
- It is different from the password you sign in with.
### Sending them
Standard Basic Authentication.
- Encode login:password in Base64.
- Send it as Authorization: Basic.
- The same header opens the hosted MCP server.

Is the DataForSEO API free?
No. A $1 trial credit and a free Sandbox, with a $50 minimum payment.
How much does the DataForSEO API cost?
DataForSEO starts at $0.60/1k SERPs. Its unit rate is $0.0006 per SERP, standard queue. It bills pay as you go or by credit pack. Read from DataForSEO's own pricing page on 24 October 2026.

title: How to Test Google Web Scraping for Free with DataForSEO Sandbox – DataForSEO
snippet:
A quick reality check first. No provider scrapes Google indefinitely for free, and you should be wary of any that claims to. But two things genuinely are free at DataForSEO, and keeping them separate is the whole point.
The first is the [DataForSEO Sandbox](https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/appendix/sandbox/), a technical environment where you send requests to any endpoint and get back responses with structure identical to production, yet without your account being charged. The second is the [free unlimited trial](https://dataforseo.com/help-center/how-does-your-free-unlimited-trial-work). When you sign up, you get a $1 credit on your balance to spend on a limited number of real API calls, but over an unlimited period.

The Sandbox is a free API testing environment for developers wiring their software up to our data. Any registered user gets access, and your account is never charged for Sandbox endpoints. It works across all of our APIs, including the SERP API, DataForSEO Labs API, and Backlinks API, so the same approach applies no matter which dataset your product needs.

Setup is short. Create a free account, then open the [API Access tab](https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/auth/) in the dashboard and copy your API login and password. The API password is generated automatically and isn’t the same as your account password.

### Does DataForSEO require a monthly subscription like most SEO tools?
No. DataForSEO operates on a pay-as-you-go model with a simple $50 minimum deposit and no recurring fees. This is a significant advantage over competitors like Semrush, which requires a $499.95/month Business plan just to unlock API access. With DataForSEO, you only pay for the data you actually use with API credits that never expire.

title: How does your free unlimited trial work? – DataForSEO
snippet:
First of all, we offer a free unlimited trial to let you try out our APIs and evaluate the efficiency of our service. To get a free trial, you should simply [create an account with DataForSEO.](https://app.dataforseo.com/register)
Once you are logged into the DataForSEO Dashboard you’ll see your API credentials for making calls from your API testing platform or through your preferred [no-code tools and AI agents.](https://dataforseo.com/integrations) Alternatively, you can use our built-in [API Playground](https://app.dataforseo.com/api-explorer/serp) which allows you to make actual API calls and obtain real JSON data through a graphic user interface.

Note that **upon registration free $1 credit for API testing will be added to your account balance**. You can use this balance to make API calls for an unlimited period of time. However, this amount will be sufficient to make a limited number of API requests.
**$1 will be enough to get, for example:**
- 800+ SERPs with high-priority tasks
- 14,000+ backlinks with Rank values and other data
- 16,000 keywords with Google Ads metrics
Note that there is no need to create another trial account to make more test APIs calls. This will be considered a violation of [DataForSEO Terms of Service](https://dataforseo.com/terms-of-service/), and such an account will be suspended.
If you feel that you need to test our service with larger API request volumes, we offer [a free Sandbox feature](https://dataforseo.com/blog/introducing-sandbox-for-dataforseo-apis) for API testing and configuration. In case this option does not suit you and you still would like to test a higher request volume, [contact us](https://dataforseo.com/contact), and we will find a solution together.
